paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.51% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+0.83%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-0.02%). Brent crude changed +0.69% to 105.44. Gold changed -0.32% to 4,202.6001. Bitcoin changed -0.23% to 83,484.6406. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.244%, a relative move of +0.25%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+3.58%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (+2.95%) moved the most.
